pub fn manifest_with_separate_build_dependencies() -> &'static str {
    r#"[package]
name = \"my-lib\"
version = \"0.1.0\"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = \"1.0\", features = [\"derive\"] }
tokio = { version = \"1\", features = [\"full\"] }

[build-dependencies]
cc = \"1.0\"
pkg-config = \"0.3\"
"#
}

pub fn build_dependencies_stay_build_only() -> bool {
    let manifest = manifest_with_separate_build_dependencies();
    manifest.contains("pkg-config") && !manifest.contains("[dependencies]\ncc =")
}
